proof.text: Write P for the genuine constant module presheaf of [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor] on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The module sheafification adjunction unit has, definitionally, underlying additive map CategoryTheory.toSheafify J P.presheaf (Mathlib PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf_map_sheafificationAdjunction_unit_app). Hence equality of two constantRealizationUnit images gives equality under this additive unit. Mathlib's GrothendieckTopology.instIsLocallyInjectiveToSheafify and Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem give a covering equalizer sieve. These generic Mathlib results allow independent site universes, unlike the specialized siteConstantModuleUnitSections lemma. They implement the same local-injectivity step from Tags 00WB/00WK and 03CY without an intermediate project lemma.

proof.text: First show that the empty sieve does not cover U. Scheme.ProEt.mem_topology_iff refines a hypothetical empty covering sieve to a presieve Q in ProEt.precoverage. Express Q as Presieve.ofArrows V f and use Scheme.ProEt.mem_precoverage_iff. The underlying family is jointly surjective by Scheme.ofArrows_mem_precoverage_iff, since a pro-etale covering is in the weakly-etale precoverage. Choose a point of U by nonemptiness and a covering member above it. Its inclusion in the empty sieve is impossible. Now, if two distinct elements of T have equal unit images, their equalizer sieve is covering by step 1, but is empty because all constant-presheaf restrictions are identity maps. This contradicts the first conclusion and proves injectivity. This is the original nonempty-cover argument, using [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor].

proof.text: For zero sections at U, ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero makes the codomain of the injective unit a subsingleton. Injectivity makes T a subsingleton, and ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton proves IsZero T. For a zero restricted sheaf, use the additive evaluation functor SheafOfModules.evaluation at op (Over.mk (identity U)); Functor.map_isZero sends the zero restricted sheaf to its zero module of sections. By the sectionwise restriction rule of [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] this evaluation is definitionally the original sections at U. Apply the first implication. These are the module category and evaluation functor of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

title: Nonempty constant sheaf detects a zero module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use its small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $U\to X$ be a site object whose underlying scheme is nonempty. Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $T$ an $R$-module. For the constant module sheaf $\underline T$ over the constant ring sheaf $\underline R$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-sf-site-constant-module-functor], the unit map $T\to\underline T(U)$ is injective. Consequently, $\underline T(U)=0$ implies $T=0$; in particular this holds if the restriction $\underline T|_U$ to the localized site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] is the zero module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].
